name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Central government scheme providing direct income support of ₹6,000 per year, paid in three installments of ₹2,000, to landholding farmer families to help meet agricultural and household expenses.
eligibilityCriteria: Farmer family (self, spouse, minor children) owns cultivable land as per state land records
Land must be registered in the farmer's name in state/revenue records
Excludes institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees above Class IV, income-tax payers, and professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs)
Small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares are the primary target group
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card (linked to bank account / NPCI-seeded)
Farmer registration / Farmer ID where applicable
applicability: any crop including wheat rice cotton sugarcane maize pulses oilseeds vegetables
rainfed or irrigated land
small and marginal holding under 2 acres and larger holdings
all states and districts across India
low annual income households needing income support

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Government-backed credit facility giving farmers short-term loans at subsidised interest rates for crop production, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities like animal husbandry and fisheries, without requiring collateral up to a threshold.
eligibilityCriteria: Farmers who own or cultivate agricultural land (owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers)
PM-KISAN beneficiaries are eligible to apply through the PM-KISAN portal or bank branch
Loans up to a set limit (commonly cited around ₹3 lakh) available without collateral
Repayment flexibility aligned with crop cycles
applicability: short term crop loan for seeds fertiliser pesticide and sowing costs
working capital for any crop wheat rice cotton sugarcane maize pulses
irrigated canal tubewell drip sprinkler or rainfed land
small marginal and medium holdings
purpose cultivation inputs animal husbandry fisheries

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss/damage from natural calamities, pests, and diseases, with low, subsidised premium rates and the balance premium paid by the government.
eligibilityCriteria: Farmers (owner or tenant) growing notified crops in notified areas
Compulsory for farmers who have availed a Kisan Credit Card or crop loan for notified crops; voluntary for others
Applicable to food crops, oilseeds, and annual commercial/horticultural crops as notified per season
requiredDocuments: Sowing certificate (for loanee/non-loanee farmers as applicable)
applicability: protection when crop is damaged by drought flood heavy rain hailstorm pest
rainfed and irrigated land alike
any notified crop wheat rice cotton sugarcane maize oilseeds pulses
purpose crop insurance premium and risk cover
all states and districts

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium-to-long-term debt financing facility for investment in post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets, such as warehouses, cold storage, and processing units, with interest subvention and credit guarantee support.
eligibilityCriteria: Farmers, FPOs (Farmer Producer Organisations), agri-entrepreneurs, cooperatives, and startups engaged in agri-infrastructure projects
Project must relate to post-harvest management or community farming assets
Interest subvention of up to 3% on loans up to a specified cap, subject to conditions
requiredDocuments: Land or lease documents for the infrastructure site
applicability: purpose warehouse cold storage godown grading sorting packhouse processing unit
post harvest infrastructure on farm or at village level
larger holdings farmer groups FPOs cooperatives and entrepreneurs
medium to high value capital investment loan

name: Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)
description: Interest subsidy scheme that reduces the effective interest rate on short-term crop loans (up to a specified limit) for farmers who repay promptly, making working-capital credit cheaper.
eligibilityCriteria: Farmers availing short-term crop loans through KCC or similar institutional credit up to the notified limit
Prompt/timely repayment required to receive the additional prompt repayment incentive
Available through public sector banks, cooperative banks, and regional rural banks
requiredDocuments: KCC or crop loan sanction documents
applicability: purpose crop loan working capital at reduced interest
short term credit for cultivation inputs
any crop and any state

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: Voluntary, contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers, providing a monthly pension after the age of 60 in exchange for monthly contributions during working years, matched by the government.
eligibilityCriteria: Small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 with up to 2 hectares of cultivable land
Not covered under other statutory social security schemes or income-tax payer status
Monthly contribution required until age 60, based on entry age
requiredDocuments: Land ownership records showing landholding size
applicability: purpose old age pension and retirement security
small and marginal holding up to 2 acres
